name: s14_fainted_ally_target
purpose: An Electric move aimed at the user's own ally that fainted earlier in the turn: getMoveTargets does not retarget a fainted ally but still runs RedirectTarget, so a foe's Lightning Rod takes Zap Cannon (-activate, then the absorb) and Electro Shot (-activate, then its charge turn) instead of [notarget]; the locked Electro Shot then goes to the replacement's slot.
